The Dashboard. Your home page shows the whole team at a glance: who is connected, work hours, productivity, websites and attendance.
Use the toolbar at the top. Choose Organization, Team or Individual, and filter by team.
Pick a range: Today, seven days, fourteen days or thirty days. Or click the calendar, to choose your own dates.
The top row shows Connected now and Work hours. The main column shows the productivity trend, websites and applications, and attendance.
The side column shows member productivity, with the top and less productive members, and recent activity. Click a person to open their profile.
To change the layout, click the Customize dashboard button, at the top right.
Drag a widget to move it. Use the buttons on each widget to rename it, or to remove it.
Click Add widget to bring one back, or to add optional widgets, like My work and Daily work hours.
Click Save dashboard. Reset returns to the standard layout. Your layout is saved for you alone.
Done. Next, set up your productivity rules.
